metadata.title: Seymour Duncan: 1 Phat Cat, 1 volume
metadata.creator: Pickup Lab; reference: Seymour Duncan
metadata.permission: Seymour Duncan encourages sharing these wiring diagrams freely; commercial use requires prior written permission. LIMITATIONS: The PDF's bridge ground wire terminates at the grounded volume casing; no bridge terminal exists in this model. Phat Cat is modeled as a two-terminal P90; the diagram's braided pickup lead cannot separately represent coil return and shield.
